decision: Research candidate only. Expanded source proof reached 10/11 roots. Narrow consumer passed three-root full request ACCA screen, but final complete regression and growth-victory/cost-dominance contracts remain. Restore production B; do not submit unvalidated runtime.

policyProof.recovery: Pinned explicit source closure; zero-healing and finite active Regen bounds; unknown initial/permanent/exhaust/returning or branch source refused.
policyProof.growth: Zero HP credit is exact equality of the entire effective growth vector with default. Future growth counts may remain unbounded; every equal-HP branch remains searchable. Positive growth credit, relic goals and PreserveResources refuse the new dominance proof.
policyProof.potions: Witness must be a complete policy-compliant victory with no death-save use. Shared tier is closed; witness cost must be known and no greater than current paid cost. Missing cost and cheaper branch remain open.
policyProof.proofSelection: Narrow consumer preserves original finite-root handling; expanded strict-HP proof is consumed only when original CanCertifyRemainingHealing is false.
policyProof.schedule: CanCertifyRemainingHealing, UsesComponentHealingCertificate, original bounds and all original Smart/opening stage admission remain unchanged. Expanded proof does not add search stages or audit quotas.
policyProof.unproved: HP source proof alone does not establish equality dominance or cap rewards. New Smart qualification remains disabled; potion stock closure unchanged.
